qualification.meaning: Source audit complete. Recorded native application and browser runs prove explicitly listed subsets on WordPress Studio/SQLite, including final plugin acceptance without a destructive restart override. Source entries, providers and broader upstream contracts are not promoted by a passing owner suite.

statusDefinitions.pending: Required implementation/proof not observed by this audit.
statusDefinitions.proven: Real executed acceptance with explicit behavior, command, revision, result and cleanup evidence.
statusDefinitions.gap: Known framework/provider/coverage difference requiring implementation or external-provider proof.
statusDefinitions.partial: Recorded execution proves a named subset; the full mapped upstream contract remains outstanding.

qualification.promotionRule: Attach behavior-specific native execution evidence, command, head/runtime identity and cleanup receipt. A passing sibling suite is not proof of every behavior mapped to its owner; record partial results separately.

backup.contract: Recover complete database plus media with platform-consistent snapshots; not just process restart.
backup.requiredProof: Restore a snapshot into a second owned native site and verify content, users, media and plugin settings.
backup.limitation: Persistent Studio restart does not prove a complete restorable backup or Cloudflare/PG recovery.

dark-media.contract: A saved dark image variant renders by theme without losing default image/metadata.
dark-media.requiredProof: Save both actual attachment variants and inspect public light/dark picture/source selection.
dark-media.limitation: A CSS dark theme alone does not prove the upstream dark-media variant feature.

image-editor.contract: Media replacement, focal point/crop, usage tracking and safe deletion update all linked public content.
image-editor.requiredProof: Use real native image editing/replacement/deletion and inspect usage, cropped bytes and downstream pages.
image-editor.limitation: Original upload/thumbnail proof alone does not cover replace/crop/usage semantics.

raw-content.contract: Rich text can include the documented HTML/CSS/JavaScript/page iframe paths under explicit permissions.
raw-content.requiredProof: Save through the actual supported native editor path and inspect public execution/rendering and access boundaries.
raw-content.limitation: Gutenberg HTML is a framework alternative; script/iframe permissions and rendering need separate evidence.
